_comment: Consumer overrides for tvDownloadOHLC. Only these keys override; everything
else inherits from agent_loop/config.py, which records WHY each default has
its value. Unknown keys are a hard error, not a silent no-op.
WHY 64000 AND NOT THE PACKAGE DEFAULT OF 96000: a budget is only valid
against a specific model's output ceiling, and nothing in the config can
express that relationship. The package default of 96000 is correct for
kimi-k2.7-code, but qwen3.5's ceiling is 65536 and it rejects the request
64000 fits under qwen3.5's ceiling AND is ample for kimi, so a run does not
break when the implementer is substituted because the primary is overloaded.
It is well above the 48000 that returned 207,078 characters of reasoning and
empty content on a five-part feature brief (O42).
_roles_comment: The implementer ROLE budget is what patch mode spends -- capping only the
plan/test MODES left it at the package default of 96000, and the first loop
run died on the same 400. The two are separate knobs and both have to fit the
model actually in use.
`model` is required alongside max_tokens and think, so the package default is
restated here; --implementer overrides it per run.
RAISED BACK TO 96000 on 2026-08-11. 64000 was chosen for the WEAKEST model
that might be substituted in, not for the one actually configured, and CM2
round 1 then died on it: kimi-k2.7-code emitted 282935 chars of thinking and
empty content at eval_count=64000. kimi has room; qwen3.5 does not. Setting
one number for both means the configured model runs at the substitute's
ceiling on every round. If you substitute qwen3.5, lower this to 64000 --
or rely on the package clamp once agent-loop records per-model output
ceilings (O59).
think=false SINCE 2026-08-11, and the budget is NOT what fixed it. On the
CM2 ticket kimi-k2.7-code returned EMPTY CONTENT twice with think=true:
64000 budget -> 282935 chars of thinking (4.42 chars/token)
96000 budget -> 435641 chars of thinking (4.54 chars/token)
Same model, same prompt, same ticket. The reasoning expanded to fill
whatever it was given, so the budget is not a control on it -- it is only
where the model gets cut off. This is the identical failure the REVIEWER
role already has a measured answer for (think=true: 159s and no verdict;
think=false: 21s and ten findings), and the answer there was think=false.
Revert this if patch quality drops; the budget stays at 96000 either way.
